structured.answer: Fees look like up to ~10 ₪ a month on the basic plan (plus maybe a card fee), but the bigger cost is that money sitting there earns 0% and shrinks: 10,000 ₪ becomes 8,203 in today's money after 10 years. So I'd keep about a month's salary there and move the rest, probably to the "קרן כספית יומית" the page points to.
